sections.heading: Launch fast. Iterate without a stack.
body: Get your marketing site, waitlist, blog — even a store — live in days, on one platform you won’t outgrow. Spend your time on the product, not the plumbing.

sections.heading: Early on, every hour counts. Instead of wiring together five tools you’ll have to rip out later, start on one platform that already does the whole job — and grows with you.
Move fast without gluing tools together.

items.title: One platform, not ten
items.body: Site, blog, forms, email, and commerce are all built in — nothing to integrate or maintain.

items.title: Your whole team, one workspace
items.body: Invite teammates with roles and work on the same site from one shared console.

items.title: Own your stack
items.body: Aglyn is Apache-2.0 and self-hostable — you can take the whole platform with you as you scale.

items.title: Ship pages in minutes
items.body: Design on a live canvas with reusable components you can reuse across every page.

items.title: Start free, pay as you grow
items.body: Begin on the free plan and upgrade only when your traffic and needs do.

items.title: From idea to live, today
items.body: Publish to your domain in one click, with SSL and a global CDN out of the box.

sections.heading: Run the whole thing from one place.
body: Site, store, forms, email, workflows, and analytics all live in one console. No juggling logins, no glue code, and no surprise integration bills as you grow.

items.title: Everything built in
items.body: Commerce, forms, media, workflows, and email are part of the platform.

items.title: Instant publishing
items.body: Ship changes to your domain in one click, with versioning to roll back.

items.title: Grow without migrating
items.body: Start free and move up tiers — the same platform the whole way.

items.title: Design it live
items.body: Open Besigner and build your pages on a real canvas — what you see is what ships.

items.title: Add what you need
items.body: Turn on forms, email, a blog, or a store as you go — no new tools.

items.title: Publish and iterate
items.body: Ship to your domain in one click, then keep editing with instant publishing.

items.title: Besigner
items.body: Design on a live canvas and publish in one click.

items.title: Analytics
items.body: Privacy-first traffic, top pages & store revenue.

sections.heading: Build your startup on Aglyn.
body: Free to start — get your site live today and add the rest as you grow.
